plan_step.title: Remove retain_graph and accumulate scalar loss
plan_step.description: Change line 104 from `loss.backward(retain_graph=True)` to `loss.backward()`. Change line 107 from `total_loss += loss` to `total_loss += loss.item()`. This eliminates per-step graph retention while preserving the exact same optimizer updates, parameter eligibility, hyperparameters, RNG, data order, objective (MSE), precision (fp32), and update cadence (one backward + one optimizer.step per step).
plan_step.risk: The host's numerical reference (original_saved_tensor_offload) will compare the first five backward scalars; scalar loss accumulation preserves the same per-step MSE values. Throughput may improve slightly from reduced memory pressure.
